names.legendary: The Cactus That Bloomed Once a Century

lore.common: Prods everyone who reaches past it for the window latch.
lore.uncommon: Is forgotten for months without water and still looks smug.
lore.rare: Stores so much water in its stem that it grows a new arm just to show off.
lore.epic: Spread across the whole windowsill with its babies until the curtains couldn't close.
lore.legendary: Bloomed one perfect pink flower after a hundred years, and the whole street came to look.

names.legendary: The Box That Sorted the Street

lore.common: Gets the wrong things put in it every single week.
lore.uncommon: Rattles with glass bottles all the way to the kerb.
lore.rare: Refuses to be collected if one yoghurt pot is unwashed.
lore.epic: Clattered so loudly on bin night that the whole street woke up at once.
lore.legendary: Sorted the whole street's rubbish so perfectly that the bin lorry crew sent it a thank-you card.

names.legendary: The Crate That Carried the Whole Party

lore.common: Overflows the morning after every party.
lore.uncommon: Stacks bottles so high that they clink in the wind.
lore.rare: Sits on the kerb so long that the crisp packets inside start a new life.
lore.epic: Toppled off the kerb and sent a hundred bottles rolling down the hill.
lore.legendary: Carried every bottle from the street party to the recycling centre in one trip.

names.legendary: The Flower That Bloomed in Winter

lore.common: Makes everyone with hay fever sneeze three times in a row.
lore.uncommon: Has a bee on it every single time you lean in to smell it.
lore.rare: Turns its head to follow the sun all day long.
lore.epic: Bloomed with a thousand friends on the same morning, and the meadow turned completely pink.
lore.legendary: Bloomed in the middle of winter through the snow, and the whole village came to see it.

names.legendary: The Tent That Survived the Summit

lore.common: Always has one pole missing when you get to the campsite.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its flysheet all night so loudly that nobody sleeps.
lore.rare: Bends in the wind so far that it almost touches the ground, then springs back.
lore.epic: Collapsed on the whole camping group in the middle of the night, and everyone woke up wearing it.
lore.legendary: Stood firm on a mountain top through a storm that blew every other tent away.

names.legendary: The Wheel That Churned the River

lore.common: Splashes everyone standing too close to the side of the boat.
lore.uncommon: Churns the river into white foam behind it.
lore.rare: Turns so fast that the boat overtakes the ducks.
lore.epic: Splashed every passenger on the river cruise, and the whole boat came back soaked.
lore.legendary: Has turned on the same river steamer for a hundred years and still carries passengers every summer.

names.legendary: Granny Flourworth of the Kitchen

lore.common: Gets flour in its pocket that puffs out every time you reach in.
lore.uncommon: Has strings that tie themselves into a knot behind your back.
lore.rare: Catches every splash of gravy, so its owner always looks spotless.
lore.epic: Was worn by every baker at the bake sale, and the hall was covered in icing sugar.
lore.legendary: Has been worn for every family feast for forty years and still has the first cake stain.

names.legendary: The Pinafore That Picked Strawberries

lore.common: Has a big bow at the back that keeps coming undone.
lore.uncommon: Is worn over everything and covered in little flowers.
lore.rare: Has pockets so deep that it carries a whole picnic.
lore.epic: Was worn by every helper at the garden party, and the lawn looked like a field of flowers.
lore.legendary: Picked every strawberry on the farm in one morning, all into its deep front pocket.

names.legendary: The Jacket That Floated a Whole Crew

lore.common: Is so bulky that its wearer can't put their arms down.
lore.uncommon: Has a little whistle attached that everyone blows on the first day.
lore.rare: Bobs its wearer so high in the water that they look like a cork.
lore.epic: Was worn by every child at the lake camp, and the water looked full of bobbing oranges.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole sailing crew floating until the lifeboat arrived, and everyone came home safe.

names.legendary: The Feeder Every Bird Knew

lore.common: Is raided by the squirrel within an hour of being filled.
lore.uncommon: Spills seeds all over the lawn, which grow into weeds.
lore.rare: Attracts so many birds that the garden sounds like a choir.
lore.epic: Brought every bird in the town to one garden on the coldest morning of winter.
lore.legendary: Fed a robin that came back every day for ten years to sit on the kitchen windowsill.

names.legendary: The House That Raised a Hundred Chicks

lore.common: Sits empty all spring while the birds nest in the hedge instead.
lore.uncommon: Has a little round hole that only the right-sized bird can fit through.
lore.rare: Chirps from inside so loudly that the cat sits underneath and stares.
lore.epic: Was moved into by a family of blue tits, and the whole garden came to watch them grow.
lore.legendary: Has raised a hundred chicks over twenty springs, and every one fledged safely.

names.legendary: The Flap That Ate the Post

lore.common: Snaps shut on the postman's fingers every single morning.
lore.uncommon: Lets in a cold draught all winter long.
lore.rare: Swallows the post and spits it onto the mat face down.
lore.epic: Snapped shut on a whole stack of birthday cards, and they scattered across the hall.
lore.legendary: Has let a million letters through the same front door for a hundred years.

names.legendary: The Mushroom Ring of the Old Wood

lore.common: Pops up overnight in the middle of the lawn, where it wasn't yesterday.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a perfect circle that people call a fairy ring.
lore.rare: Changes colour when touched, so everyone learns to look and not pick.
lore.epic: Sprouted all over the football pitch after the rain, and the match was moved to the car park.
lore.legendary: Has grown in the same ring in the same wood for three hundred years, getting a little wider each autumn.

names.legendary: The Saucer That Saved the Carpet

lore.common: Overflows every time the plant is watered.
lore.uncommon: Hides a puddle under the pot that nobody notices for weeks.
lore.rare: Becomes a hotel for every slug in the garden.
lore.epic: Overflowed under every plant on the windowsill, and the carpet got a big wet stripe.
lore.legendary: Saved a precious carpet from a hundred waterings without a single drip.

names.legendary: The Planter That Fed a Family

lore.common: Grows more weeds than flowers.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy when full of soil that nobody can move it.
lore.rare: Grows every herb the kitchen needs all summer.
lore.epic: Grew so many tomatoes that the family gave them to every neighbour on the street.
lore.legendary: Grew enough vegetables in one summer to feed a whole family every evening.

names.legendary: The Rose That Climbed the Tower

lore.common: Pricks your finger with a thorn every time you try to smell it.
lore.uncommon: Drops its petals all over the table the day after you pick it.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that bees come from three gardens away.
lore.epic: Bloomed all over the garden wall at once, and the whole street smelled of roses.
lore.legendary: Climbed all the way up the old tower and bloomed at the very top.

names.legendary: The Sled That Broke the Record

lore.common: Clatters down the ice track so loudly that the spectators cover their ears.
lore.uncommon: Takes the bends so tightly that its crew nearly touch the walls.
lore.rare: Goes so fast that the spectators only hear a whoosh.
lore.epic: Raced down the ice track in record time, and the crowd's hats blew off.
lore.legendary: Won the championship by a hundredth of a second and was kept in the museum.

names.legendary: The Sled That Crossed the Snow

lore.common: Gets pulled by dogs who bark the whole way.
lore.uncommon: Sprays snow up behind it like a little white storm.
lore.rare: Finds trails through snow that no map shows.
lore.epic: Raced across the frozen lake with twenty dogs pulling, and the whole village cheered.
lore.legendary: Crossed a whole snowy wilderness to deliver medicine to a far-away village.

names.legendary: The Board That Rode Itself Home

lore.common: Zooms off before its rider has finished standing on it.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of battery just at the bottom of the biggest hill.
lore.rare: Rolls so silently that pigeons don't notice it until too late.
lore.epic: Zoomed through the whole park so fast that the joggers felt like they were standing still.
lore.legendary: Rode itself home after its owner fell off, and waited at the front door.

names.legendary: The Board That Spun Round the House

lore.common: Wobbles under its rider until they wave their arms like a windmill.
lore.uncommon: Spins round in circles when its rider leans the wrong way.
lore.rare: Carries its rider sideways into the kitchen when they only meant to go forwards.
lore.epic: Spun round the whole living room and knocked over every lamp.
lore.legendary: Was ridden round every room in the house without touching a single wall.

names.legendary: The Jet Ski That Raced the Dolphins

lore.common: Jumps every wave so hard that its rider lands with a bump.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water over everyone on the beach.
lore.rare: Starts with such a roar that every swimmer turns round.
lore.epic: Jumped every wave in the bay in one afternoon, and the beach was soaked.
lore.legendary: Raced a pod of dolphins across the bay and came second, very happily.

names.legendary: The Ski That Won the Slalom

lore.common: Crosses over the other ski and sends its skier face first into the snow.
lore.uncommon: Falls off the ski lift and has to be fetched from the bottom.
lore.rare: Ploughs through snow so deep that it leaves a trench.
lore.epic: Tumbled down the slope with every beginner in the ski school, and they all landed in one pile.
lore.legendary: Won the slalom race by a whisker after crossing the finish line backwards.

names.legendary: The Sled That Flew Over the Bump

lore.common: Bumps into every tree on the way down the hill.
lore.uncommon: Is pulled up the hill by its rope, which always feels heavier than going down.
lore.rare: Races down the hill so fast that its rider screams with joy.
lore.epic: Raced down the hill with every sled in the village on the first snowy day.
lore.legendary: Flew over the big bump at the bottom of the hill and landed in a snowdrift with a cheer.

names.legendary: The Board That Did a Triple Spin

lore.common: Takes ten minutes to strap into, then falls over straight away.
lore.uncommon: Spends more time on its rider's bottom than on the snow.
lore.rare: Flies up the half-pipe so high that its rider waves to the ski lift.
lore.epic: Did a trick in the half-pipe that every snowboarder on the mountain tried to copy.
lore.legendary: Spun three times in the air and landed perfectly in the final.

names.legendary: The Board That Rode the Giant Wave

lore.common: Wipes out its rider on every second wave.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in wax that sticks to everyone's feet.
lore.rare: Catches waves that nobody else can even see coming.
lore.epic: Caught the biggest wave of the day with every surfer on the beach watching.
lore.legendary: Rode the biggest wave of the year all the way to the beach, and the whole town cheered.

names.legendary: The Mattress That Floated to the Island

lore.common: Slowly leaks overnight so you wake up on the floor.
lore.uncommon: Takes an hour of pumping before it's even half full.
lore.rare: Floats on the lake so gently that its rider falls asleep.
lore.epic: Leaked under every camper on the same night, and the whole tent woke up on the ground.
lore.legendary: Floated a sleeping holidaymaker all the way across the bay to a tiny island.

names.legendary: The Mat That Found Every Stone

lore.common: Fights back every time you try to roll it up.
lore.uncommon: Is so thin that you feel every pebble under your back.
lore.rare: Finds the one stone under the tent and puts it right under your hip.
lore.epic: Was rolled out by every camper at the scout camp, and the hall floor disappeared.
lore.legendary: Has camped on every mountain in the country and still rolls up tightly.

names.legendary: The Mat Under the Stars

lore.common: Slips across the tent floor all night so you end up by the door.
lore.uncommon: Crinkles every time you turn over.
lore.rare: Catches the morning dew so the sleeping bag stays dry.
lore.epic: Was laid out by everyone for the stargazing night, and the field looked like a patchwork.
lore.legendary: Lay under a shooting star shower so bright that its sleeper made a hundred wishes.

names.legendary: The Tallest Sunflower in the Village

lore.common: Droops its heavy head so low that it looks sad.
lore.uncommon: Turns to face the sun all day, so every photo is from behind.
lore.rare: Grows a centimetre taller every time someone measures it.
lore.epic: Bloomed in a field so huge that the whole hill turned yellow.
lore.legendary: Grew taller than the village church roof, and the birds held a feast on its seeds.

names.legendary: The Bin That Fed the Garden

lore.common: Creaks its lid open and lets out a smell that clears the garden.
lore.uncommon: Is home to a thousand wriggling worms.
lore.rare: Turns banana skins into soil so fast that the gardener suspects magic.
lore.epic: Turned a whole summer of garden clippings into soil, and the vegetables grew huge.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole allotment with its soil for twenty years.
